Like a Dragon: Kenzan! Side Content Guide

Version 0.1. Follow all 140 substories with detailed walkthroughs, an interactive map, story objective filters, and checklists for training, inventions, and collectibles. The guide also covers yūjo routes and Revelations. Your checkmarks are saved in your browser.

This fan project was vibe-coded with AI assistance while playing the English translation.

Interactive mapCollectiblesMissable quests and rewards

Pick your current story objective to see unfinished substories you can work on, including quests from earlier chapters. A red prerequisite warning flags requirements the guide can’t confirm. Your quest and collectible checkmarks are saved in this browser and sync with the interactive map. Select a quest pin and use Previous and Next in the top-left panel to follow its steps. Use map layers to show or hide venues, routes, and collectibles.

If your objective is still to bring the monk to the Information Booth, you're in late Chapter 4. The side quests below begin in Chapter 5. The earlier shop collections for Ito are part of the prologue.

Substories by chapter

Kenzan has 100 Requests, 20 Commissions, and 20 Bounties. Requests start through encounters around town. Commissions come from clients or letters, often near Tatsuya. Bounties start at the wanted board in northwest Rakugai. Read the individual poster to learn when and where the target appears.

First window gives the earliest story checkpoint where a quest can become available. In 5-2, 5 is the chapter and 2 is the second checkpoint in this guide. The objective beside the code is the story task you’re about to do. The Clock column gives the story time before you do it. Check each quest’s own time and prerequisites. Finished counts toward completion, even if another outcome would pay more.

In Patrick Coffman’s walkthrough, Suburbs means Rakugai, Monmae means Monzen Alley, and Kawara means Kawaramachi.

5-3 is the daytime conversation with Itō. Commissions #103 and #104 unlock after he tells you about Kōetsu, in 5-4, when the next objective is to meet Shichigoro. Japanese commission reference

Start with #101 The Insurmountable Debtor, a quick 1 ryō job behind Tsuruya. Do #104 Storage Locker Instructions as soon as you can so keys begin appearing as you explore. Requests #1–7 are the yūjo routes at Yumejiya and Azamiya. #8 can be worked on one completed route at a time and #9 follows it. Save the expensive routes for when you have more money.

Requests

#1 Kinuyo of Yumejiya

Start
Gion Inari Shrine, Gion
Available
5-1 · Any time · Show on map
Requires
Max Kinuyo's heart gauge at Yumejiya.
Yūjo profile
Kinuyo’s preferences and dialogue
Story cutoff
Finish the Gion steps before telling Ito you’re ready to leave in 12-3.
  1. Meet Kinuyo at Gion Inari Shrine. Go to the Gion gate and approach Tsurumaru while he is talking with a yujo.
  2. Report back to Kinuyo at Gion Inari Shrine. Find Tsurumaru with another yujo on the small lane west of Gion’s main street, immediately south of Nakatsuji. Talk to him after she leaves.
  3. Win the fight and return to Kinuyo at Gion Inari Shrine for 2,000 XP.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. After filling Kinuyo’s hearts at Yumejiya, meet her at Gion Inari Shrine.
  2. Walk to the Gion Main Gate and approach Tsurumaru while he’s with another yūjo. Go back to the shrine to tell Kinuyo what happened.
  3. From Gion’s main street, turn into the little lane immediately south of Nakatsuji on the west side. Wait for Tsurumaru’s companion to leave before speaking to him.
  4. Defeat Tsurumaru and make one last trip to Kinuyo at Gion Inari Shrine to collect 2,000 XP.

Start
Gion Inari Shrine, Gion

Yūjo profile

Yūjo profile

Finish the Gion steps before telling Ito you’re ready to leave in 12-3.

Start

Yūjo profile

Story cutoff
Finish the Gion steps before telling Ito you’re ready to leave in 12-3.

  4. Win the fight against Toramaro’s two men. You get your 50 ryō back and earn 10,000 XP.

#8 Gion Guidebook

Start
Guidebook author near the Gion gate and Arigataya Market
Available
5-2 · Any time · Show on map
Requires
Complete at least one of Requests #1, #2, #3, #4, #5, #6, #7 to start. All seven are required to finish.
Story cutoff
Finish the Gion steps before telling Ito you’re ready to leave in 12-3.
  1. Agree to share information with the author and answer four questions per yujo. He only asks about yujo whose requests you have finished.
  2. For the best payment, choose these answers in order. Kinuyo 3/3/2/1, Suzukaze 3/1/2/1, Momochika 1/2/2/3, Hinagiku 3/1/2/1, Hanamaru 1/2/2/3, Shirayuki 2/2/3/2, Asagiri 1/2/1/3. Count from the top.
  3. Enter and leave Arigataya after each set, then return for the payment and the next set. Incorrect answers reduce payment but still count. Finish all seven for 15,000 XP.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. Complete at least one of the seven yūjo requests, then find the author near the Gion gate and Arigataya Market. Pick the first option to hear him out, then the first again to share what you know.
  2. Give four answers for the yūjo he names. Count the choices from the top. Kinuyo: 3, 3, 2, 1. Suzukaze: 3, 1, 2, 1. Momochika: 1, 2, 2, 3. Hinagiku: 3, 1, 2, 1. Hanamaru: 1, 2, 2, 3. Shirayuki: 2, 2, 3, 2. Asagiri: 1, 2, 1, 3.
  3. After each interview, enter Arigataya Market and step back out. Speak to the author again to collect 1 ryō for a perfect set or 5,000 mon if you missed an answer.
  4. Repeat as you finish the remaining yūjo requests. All seven interviews count even with wrong answers, and the last one earns 15,000 XP.

#10 The Togarashi Girl

Start
Shijo Avenue East near Yasaka Shrine Entrance, Rakugai
Available
5-6 · Day or evening · Show on map
Requires
Bring 10 mon.
  1. Buy a pepper from the girl in red, then walk away until two men approach her.
  2. Speak to their leader and choose the first option to intervene. Beat both men for 1,500 XP.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. At the Yasaka Shrine end of Shijo Avenue East, look for the girl dressed in red with an oversized pepper on her back. Buy a pepper from her for 10 mon.
  2. Walk away far enough to trigger the scene with two men. Turn back and talk to the man harassing her.
  3. Choose the first response to step in, then beat both men. The scene with the girl closes the request for 1,500 XP.

#11 Hole in the Shoji

Start
House on the south side of Ebisu Street, west of Hanami Alley South, Rakugai
Available
5-6 · Day or evening · Show on map
Requires
Complete #10 The Togarashi Girl.
  1. Talk to the old man outside his house and take the second option to keep watch. Talk to the visitor who peers at the door.
  2. Head north along Hanami Alley South to find the fleeing man peeking around a corner south of the Blacksmith. Beat him and hear his explanation back at the Ebisu Street house.
  3. Find Ukichi in front of the Gion Main Gate on Shijo Avenue and beat him as well. Return to the house on Ebisu Street for an incense burner and 1,500 XP.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. After #10, speak to the old man on the south side of Ebisu Street, west of Hanami Alley South. Pick the second option when he asks you to watch the house.
  2. Approach the visitor when he peers at the paper door. He runs north. Go up Hanami Alley South and look for him peeking from a corner just south of the Blacksmith.
  3. Beat him, then hear his explanation at the house. He points you to Ukichi, the man who spread the rumor.
  4. Find Ukichi on Shijo Avenue in front of the Gion Main Gate, on the Rakugai side. Defeat him and go back to the old man’s house for the incense burner and 1,500 XP.

Start

#16 The Fiance

Start
Western end of Kawaramachi’s main avenue
Available
5-12 · Day or evening · Show on map
Story unlock
After defeating the yakuza's bodyguard. The story requirement clears at 5-11. Show the permit to reach Kawaramachi.
Requires
Unequip any Resurrection Magatama before the fight.
  1. Approach Okiku standing alone and follow her scene into the fight with Tasuke.
  2. Let Tasuke defeat Kiryu on purpose. Your health is restored after the scene and you receive a tortoiseshell hairpin and 1,500 XP.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. Before approaching Okiku at the west end of Kawaramachi’s main avenue, remove any equipped Resurrection Magatama.
  2. Follow the encounter into the fight with Tasuke. Let him win for the hairpin outcome. Leave your guard down and give him room to attack if he keeps trying to tackle you.

  1. Talk to the two men on the Kawaramachi side of Shijo Bridge. Look for Gonnosuke talking to a woman on the north side of the avenue, just west of the turnoff to Kōetsu’s mansion. Approach him twice.
  2. Refuse the 3 ryō demand with the second option and win the fight. Agree to look for him with the first option when his wife asks.
  3. Find Gonnosuke again at the eastern end of Shijo Avenue East, near the Yasaka Shrine entrance in Rakugai. Approach him to reunite the pair and receive produce and 1,500 XP.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. Finish #16, then speak to the two men on the south side of the Kawaramachi approach to Shijo Bridge.
  2. Follow the avenue west and check its north side just beyond the turn for Kōetsu’s mansion. Approach Gonnosuke and the woman, then approach him again after the first exchange.
  3. Refuse the demand for 3 ryō with the second response and win the fight. When his wife asks you to help find him, choose the first response.
  4. Cross into Rakugai and follow Shijo Avenue East to the Yasaka Shrine entrance. Approach Gonnosuke to reunite them and collect the produce and 1,500 XP.

#36 The Togarashi Girl's Father

Start
Togarashi girl's usual spot on Shijo Avenue East, Rakugai
Available
Starts at Chapter 6-3, day or evening. Delivery is daytime, first available at 7-5. · Show on map
Story unlock
After Musashi starts to look for training.
Requires
Complete #11 Hole in the Shoji. The poultice needs a material obtained from #47.
Inventions
Gyotensai’s recipes and materials
Story cutoff
Get the poultice from Gyotensai before Gion closes in 12-3.
  1. Choose the first option to accompany the girl home. Talk to her father in Nagayamachi for the Togarashi Set.
  2. After #47 Talent, take one Washi and the Togarashi Set to Gyotensai at the east end of Tsurumachi Alley in Gion. Show him the set to unlock Back Pain Remedy. Buy Dried Agar from the turtle vendor on Shijo Avenue in Rakugai and select it when the recipe asks for Something Adhesive. The result is Togarashi Poultice.
  3. Give the poultice to the father during the day. Wait at least three minutes, change areas and return to the girl's usual stall to see them again. Earn 1,500 XP and a replacement poultice.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. After #11, visit the girl on Shijo Avenue East by the eastern save point in Rakugai. Choose the first reply to go home with her. Speak to her father in Nagayamachi and take the Togarashi Set.
  2. Complete #47 Talent when the Chapter 7 night window opens. It gives you two Washi. Reserve one for this request and another for #97.
  3. Buy Dried Agar from the turtle seller on Shijo Avenue. Bring it, one Washi and the Togarashi Set to Gyotensai’s house at the east end of Tsurumachi Alley in Gion.
  4. Show Gyotensai the set and choose Back Pain Remedy. Select Dried Agar for Something Adhesive. Take the resulting Togarashi Poultice back to the father during daylight. The first daytime delivery window is 7-5.
  5. Allow at least three minutes to pass, change areas and revisit the pepper stall to see the father and daughter together. The final conversation awards 1,500 XP and a replacement poultice.

#38 Today's Excuses

Outside Sake Ikkonya, Rakugai

Commissions

#112 The Appraisal

Start
Gion · Read the Tatsuya letter from Sake Nakanokura and visit its proprietor
Available
7-5 · Any time · Show on map
Story unlock
After the talk with Haruka.
Requires
The Targeted Yujo (#107)
Story cutoff
Finish the Gion steps before telling Ito you’re ready to leave in 12-3.
  1. Visit the debtor’s house immediately south of the blacksmith in Rakugai and refuse to leave. Examine the plate and insist twice that you want it, then accept the pot and hanging scroll he offers.
  2. Take both items to Kōetsu’s mansion in Kawaramachi. Entering can advance the story if the current objective is to visit Kōetsu. Finish your other errands first, then leave and re-enter after the story scene to get the appraisal.
  3. Bring 1 ryō back to the proprietor at Sake Nakanokura to settle the debt. Kōetsu pays 12 ryō for the items, leaving you 11 ryō ahead.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. Read the Sake Nakanokura letter at Tatsuya, then speak to the proprietor in the shop. In Rakugai, look for the debtor’s front door immediately south of the Blacksmith and go inside when Kiryu recognizes it.
  2. When the debtor asks you to leave, stay. Examine the plate among his wares and insist on taking it twice. Accept his alternative offer of the pot and hanging scroll.
  3. Bring both items to Kōetsu’s mansion in Kawaramachi. If your current story objective also sends you there, finish other errands first. The story scene takes priority, so leave and enter again afterward to get the appraisal.
  4. Sell both pieces to Kōetsu for 12 ryō total. Return to Sake Nakanokura and hand over 1 ryō. You keep 11 ryō and earn 1,500 XP.

  2. Find Yosaburo across from the blacksmith and choose the second reply to ask about his vow. Return to the dojo corner, speak to Manta and choose the second reply there too.
  3. Go back to Yosaburo and use the first reply to tell him about Manta’s vow. Return to the corner and watch the two men speak again.
  4. Follow their trail to Gion. Speak to the attendant on eastern Nakatsuji Alley and defeat the men inside. You earn 3 ryō and 1,500 XP.

#97 Flying Towards the Future

Start
Gion · Gyotensai’s house at the east end of Tsurumachi Alley
Available
10-11 · Any time to start, finish in daylight at 11-2 · Show on map
Story unlock
After Haruka has been kidnapped.

Inventions
Gyotensai’s recipes and materials
Story cutoff
Do the Cliffside Path scene during the Chapter 11 daytime window. Leave at least one invention unfinished until the quest starts.
  1. Enter Gyotensai's house and encourage his idea for a flying machine. If the scene fails to start, talk to him, step outside, then reenter.
  2. Bring him the rake beside the stable in the middle of the Countryside Path, then the bamboo sticks south of the Rakugai blacksmith, and finally the washi paper. Agree to test the machine (bottom option).
  3. During daylight in Chapter 11, talk to the people at the south end of Cliffside Path. Look for the interaction prompt just west of the bridge to launch the machine.
  4. Return to Gyotensai's house after the rescue.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. Make Sober Pill, Hunger Pill and Ultra All-Purpose Medicine, but leave at least one invention unfinished until the request starts. Keep a Washi from #47 for the flying machine.
  2. Enter Gyotensai’s workshop at the east end of Tsurumachi Alley in Gion and encourage his flying machine idea. If the scene does not appear, talk to him and re-enter the workshop.
  3. Pick up the rake at the stables around the middle of Countryside Path and deliver it to Gyotensai. Next collect the bamboo sticks south of the Rakugai blacksmith and bring them to the workshop.
  4. Hand over the Washi. Once the machine is ready, choose the second option to agree to a test.
  5. During the Chapter 11 daylight window at 11-2, meet Gyotensai at the south end of Cliffside Path. Do this before leaving for Yagyu Village. Inspect the spot west of the bridge to launch the machine for the rescue.
  6. Return to the workshop in Gion after the rescue to finish the request.

  2. Back at the dojo, tell the woman you think she is faking (bottom option). Speak to her again right away and give her the egg (top option) before leaving the area.
Detailed walkthrough
  1. After #91, speak to the elderly woman west of Yoshioka Dojo. Go back to the chicken farmer just inside the Countryside Path entrance from the dojo.
  2. The second option pays 500 mon outright. For the 100 mon price, choose to haggle, offer 200 mon, choose to haggle again, then select the middle option for 100 mon.
  3. Back at Yoshioka Dojo, talk to the woman and pick the second option to call out her act. Speak to her again immediately and give her the egg with the first option. Do this before leaving the area to receive the Ninigi Spirit Pearl.

Scribd substory guide · Original GameFAQs walkthrough

Yūjo

What you’re trying to do

Reach 20 hearts to unlock each yūjo’s substory. Complete her special conversations at 11, 16, and 20 hearts, then finish the visit with the gauge full. The gauge holds only 10 hearts at first, so you’ll need to raise its limit as you go.

How visits work

Request a yūjo at Yumejiya or Azamiya in Gion. Liked orders and good dialogue answers build hearts. The room fee is separate from the price of your drink and dish. Green Tea is free, and skipping either order costs a quarter heart. Each profile lists order reactions and puts the best dialogue answers in bold.

Gifts are optional. Bring a liked item in your inventory if you need a boost. The gift prompt can appear from the second visit. Use a reward or spare item you already own before paying for one. Giving it uses up the item, and repeating a gift can lose hearts. A gift bought on a date uses that venue’s separate preference list.

Parlor games are short contests the yūjo offers during a visit. Yumejiya has Bottle Knockdown, a bowling game, and Konpira Fune Fune, a rhythm game with a tabletop piece. Azamiya has Fan Toss, where you aim a fan at a target, and Iroha Karuta, where you grab the card matching a spoken cue. See the minigame tips for how to play.

Heart milestones

  1. 6 hearts unlocks the first game. From your third separate visit, reach 6 hearts by the end of the third conversation. Winning adds 2 hearts and raises the limit from 10 to 15. Choose Extend Session to keep talking.
  2. 11 hearts opens the date. Check her letter for the meeting spot. Arrive within two minutes for +1 heart. A successful date raises the limit to 20, and buying something she likes waives the return room fee.
  3. 16 hearts opens the later game. Aim for 16 by the third conversation on the date return. A win adds 2 hearts. Extend to keep talking and reach 20 with a conversation slot left for her final special dialogue.

What can interrupt your progress

Running into another yūjo on a date. At the venue, you can run into a yūjo you’ve already visited whose substory is still unfinished. A bad reply can cost 3 hearts with either woman, and some replies end the date. Use the safe reply under Dates and encounters, or finish one yūjo’s substory before visiting another.

Getting too drunk. Alcohol orders and some dialogue replies make Kiryu drink. At 950 intoxication the staff end the visit and you lose 1 heart, cutting off the rest of that session’s conversations and games. Start sober, use Green Tea to lower intoxication, and favor replies that skip the sake when your intoxication is already high.

How to spend less

Follow the visit-by-visit route in each profile. End visit two after the third conversation unless her route calls for an extension. The date return starts at the order menus, so use your gift and equipment bonuses on visits two and three.

The estimates assume 0–5 handsomeness, no gifts, the best replies that avoid sake unless the route specifies one, early date arrival, and both games won. Costs include one room fee per paid visit and the repeat orders after the games. Better gear or a gift you already own can cut some totals further. If you fall short of the heart milestones, budget another visit.

Visit and date dialogue cross-checked with KHHSubs’ Yūjo guide.

KinuyoSuzukazeMomochikaHinagikuHanamaruShirayukiAsagiri
More visit and date rules
  • Losing a parlor game costs 1 heart and can mean another drink.
  • Taking more than 10 minutes to meet your date costs 3 hearts. A liked meal or gift earns +1 heart. A neutral choice leaves the return fee in place. A disliked choice costs 1 heart and ends the outing.
  • Falling below the venue’s minimum funds costs 2 hearts. Being short of the return visit fee costs 1 heart.
  • Reaching 800–949 intoxication can award +2 hearts. Sake served during some answers adds 300–600 intoxication. Use a Sober Pill before a visit if you’re already drunk.
  • The first visit has two conversations. Later visits can offer more at higher hearts. An extension opens the food and drink menus again and keeps the same visit count.
  • From the second visit, equipped items can change the starting heart gauge through the hidden handsomeness score. Each profile lists the heart changes and any item she scores differently.
  • Each listed date encounter can happen once. Asagiri’s dates have no encounters with other yūjo.

Sources include the installed game files and the Japanese Yūjo guide.

Kinuyo

Yumejiya, Gion · 2,500 mon per visit · #1 Kinuyo of Yumejiya

Low-cost route

  1. Room orders.
    • Every order round. Green Tea + skip the food (Free, −0.25 hearts).
  2. Date. Meet at Gion Main Gate within two minutes and order Large Futomaki at Sushi Ginya (100 mon, +2 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) to waive the return room fee. For an extra 80 mon, Large Red Bean Rice at Hatsukaze Kitchen (180 mon, +3 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) can help if you’re short on hearts.
  3. If you need more hearts. An inexpensive room order is Green Tea + Pickles (30 mon, +0.5 hearts). An Incense Burner from #11 earns +1. A Potted Chrysanthemum from #44 earns +2 if you already have it.

7,600 mon estimated cost to unlock her substory. Three paid visits, the date, and the orders above.

The free-order plan uses the sake reply “You don’t have to force yourself to drink.” when it comes up. For an alcohol-free route, give a +2 gift on visit 2 or add Pickles on visit 2 and both order rounds of visit 3 (90 mon extra).

Suzukaze

Yumejiya, Gion · 2,500 mon per visit · #2 Suzukaze of Yumejiya

Low-cost route

  1. Room orders.
    • Every order round. Skip drink and food (Free, −0.5 hearts).
  2. Date. Meet at Gion Inari Shrine entrance within two minutes and order Large Mushizushi at Sushi Ginya (140 mon, +1 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) to waive the return room fee. For an extra 120 mon, Large Boiled Tofu at Hatsukaze Kitchen (260 mon, +2 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) can help if you’re short on hearts.
  3. If you need more hearts. An inexpensive room order is Green Tea + Red and White Manju (50 mon, +0.25 hearts). Konpeito earns +1. It costs 500 mon from Arigataya Market in Rakugai or the candy seller there. The seller’s discounted stock costs 250 mon.

7,640 mon estimated cost to unlock her substory. Three paid visits, the date, and the orders above.

Momochika

Yumejiya, Gion · 5,000 mon per visit · #3 Momochika of Yumejiya

Low-cost route

  1. Room orders.
    • Visit 3 after the game. skip the drink + Dried Squid (80 mon, +0.25 hearts).
    • Other rounds. Skip drink and food (Free, −0.5 hearts).
  2. Date. Meet at Gion Main Gate within two minutes and order Large Kohada Oshizushi at Sushi Ginya (100 mon, +3 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) to waive the return room fee.
  3. If you need more hearts. An inexpensive room order is skip the drink + Dried Squid (80 mon, +0.25 hearts). Itami Sake from Sake Nakanokura’s takeout menu costs 50 mon and earns +1. Cloudy Sake from Sake Ikkonya costs 40 mon and also earns +1.

1 ryō 5,180 mon estimated cost to unlock her substory. Three paid visits, the date, and the orders above. The minimum fixed charges are 1 ryō 5,100 mon with the cheapest liked date and free room orders.

Skip the Dried Squid if you give a +1 gift you already own on visit 2 or have 6–15 handsomeness on visits 2 and 3.

Hinagiku

Azamiya, Gion · 1,500 mon per visit · #4 Hinagiku of Azamiya

Low-cost route

  1. Room orders.
    • Every order round. Green Tea + skip the food (Free, +0.25 hearts).
  2. Date. Meet at Gion Inari Shrine entrance within two minutes and order Large Futomaki at Sushi Ginya (100 mon, +2.5 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) to waive the return room fee. If you miss the early greeting, pick the menu option labeled Hatsukaze Kitchen to go to Sushi Ginya.
  3. If you need more hearts. An inexpensive room order is Green Tea + Red and White Manju (50 mon, +1.5 hearts). Konpeito earns +2. It costs 500 mon from Arigataya Market in Rakugai or the candy seller there. The seller’s discounted stock costs 250 mon.

4,600 mon estimated cost to unlock her substory. Three paid visits, the date, and the orders above.

Hanamaru

Azamiya, Gion · 1,500 mon per visit · #5 Hanamaru of Azamiya

Low-cost route

  1. Room orders.
    • Date return after the game. Green Tea + Pickles (30 mon, 0 hearts).
    • Other rounds. Green Tea + skip the food (Free, −0.25 hearts).
  2. Date. Meet at Gion Main Gate within two minutes and order Large Mushizushi at Sushi Ginya (140 mon, +2 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) to waive the return room fee. For an extra 100 mon, Large Rikyu-Style Egg at Hatsukaze Kitchen (240 mon, +3 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) can help if you’re short on hearts.
  3. If you need more hearts. An inexpensive room order is Green Tea + Dried Squid (80 mon, +1 hearts). An Incense Burner from #11 earns +1. If you already have the Glass Kiseru from #53, it earns +2.

4,670 mon estimated cost to unlock her substory. Three paid visits, the date, and the orders above. The minimum fixed charges are 4,640 mon with the cheapest liked date and free room orders. Keep 1 ryō for the medicine in her substory.

Skip the Pickles if you give a +1 gift you already own on visit 2 or have 6–15 handsomeness on visits 2 and 3.

Shirayuki

Azamiya, Gion · 4,000 mon per visit · #6 Shirayuki of Azamiya

Low-cost route

  1. Room orders.
    • Visit 3 after the game · Date return after the game. skip the drink + Red and White Manju (50 mon, −0.25 hearts).
    • Other rounds. Skip drink and food (Free, −0.5 hearts).
  2. Date. Meet at Gion Inari Shrine entrance within two minutes and order Large Fried Egg at Hatsukaze Kitchen (200 mon, +2.5 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) to waive the return room fee.
  3. If you need more hearts. An inexpensive room order is Blackcurrant Liquor + Red and White Manju (150 mon, +0.5 hearts). A Potted Chrysanthemum from #44 earns +2 if you have one. Kyoto Perfume Sachet from Arigataya Market in Gion earns +1 and costs 2,000 mon.

1 ryō 2,300 mon estimated cost to unlock her substory. Three paid visits, the date, and the orders above. The minimum fixed charges are 1 ryō 2,100 mon with the cheapest liked date and free room orders.

With a +2 gift on visit 2 or 16+ handsomeness on visits 2 and 3, skip all room orders and get Large Futomaki at Sushi Ginya for 100 mon. That drops the estimated total to 1 ryō 2,100 mon.

Asagiri

Yumejiya, Gion · 1 ryō per visit · #7 Asagiri of Yumejiya

Complete substories #1, #2, #3, #4, #5, #6 to visit Asagiri.

Low-cost route

  1. Room orders.
    • Visit 2 · Visit 3 start · Date return start. skip the drink + Fresh Vegetables (100 mon, −0.25 hearts).
    • Visit 3 after the game. skip the drink + Grilled Sparrow (400 mon, +0.25 hearts).
    • Other rounds. Skip drink and food (Free, −0.5 hearts).
  2. Date. Meet at Gion Inari Shrine entrance within two minutes and order Large Mushizushi at Sushi Ginya (140 mon, +1.5 hearts with early arrival, before the cap) to waive the return room fee.
  3. If you need more hearts. An inexpensive room order is skip the drink + Grilled Tuna Head (1,000 mon, +0.75 hearts). A spare Old Taiken or Rusted Old Taiken earns +1. A Polishing Cloth earns +2. #12 gives you two cloths for 200 mon.

3 ryō 840 mon estimated cost to unlock her substory. Three paid visits, the date, and the orders above. The minimum fixed charges are 3 ryō 140 mon with the cheapest liked date and free room orders. Have 50 ryō available for her substory. You get it back after the fight.

A +2 gift on visit 2 lets you skip all room orders and brings the estimate to 3 ryō 140 mon, or 3 ryō 340 mon if you spend the 200 mon to get the cloths from #12. With an owned +1 gift on visit 2, buy Fresh Vegetables only after the visit 3 game and at the start of the date return. That also comes to 3 ryō 340 mon.

  1. Even so, after I get up and go about "the usual," I start feelin' like myself again before long. Do ya know what "the usual" is for me?

    Full prompt

    Us yujo usually stay awake until the crack of dawn and sleep through the morning.
    Well, I guess you have no other choice.
    Still, it's hard for me to sleep for very long, and I get woken up before noon, so I never really feel well-rested.
    Must be rather difficult.
    Even so, after I get up and go about "the usual," I start feelin' like myself again before long. Do ya know what "the usual" is for me?

    1. Taking A Bath (0)
    2. Eating (−1)
    3. Getting Dressed (+1)

Revelations

The First window is the earliest story objective for a Revelation. Check the time of day and prerequisites before heading to the pin.

Revelations teach Heat Actions. After Itō tells you about Kōetsu in Chapter 5, meet Shichigoro in the back alley near Tsuruya, then follow him to Gion Inari Shrine. Watch for his later letters and return to the shrine for his pictures. The Collection Rewards checklist shows where to get every picture. Find Shichigoro at the shrine.

Finish Revelations that require Gion before telling Itō you’re ready to leave at 12-3. Check Missable quests and rewards for one-time picture rewards.

Get the required picture, then go to the observation spot at the listed time of day and interact with the prompt. Follow the timed inputs shown in your game, then select the insight below. The sequences use PlayStation button names. If you miss an input or choose the wrong insight, leave the area and return to retry.

Collectibles

Use the Locker Keys table for all 51 key locations and 50 locker rewards. Open a group below for other collectibles. Select an item’s name to jump to its pin. Collected checkmarks sync with the interactive map. Wild turtle spawns are repeatable.

Check story-stage pickups before leaving the area. Some are only available during that part of the story.

Turtle Rescues (8)

When you find an overturned turtle during the story, interact with it to turn it upright. Each of the four rescues unlocks a special turtle with higher potential for racing. You only have one chance to save each one.

From 5-6, get the free Turtle Bucket from the turtle vendor in Rakugai and use it to raise turtles at Tatsuya. Rescued turtles show up there after turtles in your care die. Miyamoto appears after 1 death and can reach the maximum sand stat, Temple after 2 for water, Farm after 3 for mud, and Riverbed after 4 for speed. The pickup rows show where to collect them for the races in Gion.

Kakemawari jobs and debt collection

A kakemawari takes paid jobs such as recovering debts, guarding a business, or delivering something. Check the area around Tatsuya and its letters whenever you return to Gion. Some clients approach you directly. 1 ryō equals 10,000 mon. Kakemawari walkthroughs · English walkthrough

The early debt collection chain

  1. #101 The Insurmountable Debtor. Find the injured collectors in Kamemachi Alley, behind Tsuruya. Speak to Kumanosuke at Sushi Ginya, accept his challenge, and win for 1 ryō and 1,000 XP.

  2. #108 Acting Head Clerk. From Chapter 6, speak to the Horaiya clerk by outdoor mahjong on Tsurumachi Alley. Admit customers 1, 4 and 5. Refuse 2 and 3 and win their fights. Refuse 6 twice. This pays 1 ryō and 1,500 XP.

  3. #109 Debt Collection. Talk to the Azamiya clerk outside Tatsuya. Find Shokichi’s house on Hanami Alley near the Nagayamachi junction in Rakugai. Decline the other collectors’ fight twice, then check behind the house. Refuse to let Shokichi go twice, win the fight, and return to the clerk for 5,000 mon and 1,500 XP.

  4. #110 A Real Man Never Turns Back follows #109. Find the men wedged in the alley north of Sake Nakanokura. Approach from the east and push them toward Gion’s main street.

Japanese commission route

Jobs worth doing for cash

  • #111 Yojimbo for Ebisuya pays 2 ryō if you offer to buy the samurai’s sword after beating him. Complete #104, read the letter at Tatsuya, then visit Ebisuya Pawn. This covers the Chapter 6 cash requirement on its own.

  • #106 Poor Client, Great Master needs 5 ryō in hand. Pay the collectors, then sell the scroll at Ebisuya for 10 ryō, a 5 ryō profit. Complete #105 first. If #36 is active, finish it before looking for this job.

  • #112 The Appraisal. After #107, read the letter at Tatsuya and speak to the proprietor at Sake Nakanokura. In the debtor’s house near the Rakugai blacksmith, decline to leave and show interest in the plate. Take the pot and hanging scroll when offered. Have Koetsu appraise them, then settle up at Nakanokura for 11 ryō net.

Japanese commission checklist

Missable quests and rewards

The chapter tables show the first chance to start a quest. Many stay available later if you return at the right time of day and meet their prerequisites.

Story deadlines

  • Chapter 11, before leaving for Yagyu Village (11-2). Do the daylight Cliffside Path scene for #97 Flying Towards the Future and start #99 A Man's Pride on Forest Path. For #97, leave at least one invention unfinished until the quest starts. Japanese request guide · ThePatrick’s walkthrough

  • Finale, before telling Ito you’re ready to leave (12-3). Gion closes for the rest of the story. Finish the yūjo and guidebook chains, commissions and Revelations that need Gion, and any Gion steps in quests you started elsewhere, such as #99. Finish your Gion dojo lessons and inventions before leaving. Buy Bassarimaru at Ebisuya Pawn for #20 and pick up Gyotensai’s poultice for #36. You can hand those in later.

  • Finale, before boarding the boat (12-5). Finish the remaining quests outside Gion. Koetsu can change the time of day here. Use evening for #140 Kuroshima Raiden and night for the follow-up in #100 Justice For All.

One-time outcomes

  • #56 Riot at the Blacksmith is the only chance to use Essence of Bellows. Do it in one of the smithy fights.

  • In #75 Enkiridera, stay after the first fight for the Meditating Monk Picture. In #85 Gion's Famous Doctor 2, agree to look for Ken for the Fly Picture. Both pictures unlock Heat Action revelations.

  • Catch at least one cat in #58 Like a Cat to Catnip to play #59 Like a Cat to Coins. With zero cats, #59 is recorded as Finished and you skip the scene. A Finished result still counts for substory completion.

  • The four one-time turtle rescues occur at 1-4, 2-1, 3-2, and 7-2. Turn the turtles over before advancing the story in those areas.

  • Pick up Ancient Shichishito in the third-floor Tsuruya storeroom during 7-14. In Kyoto Adventure, you can obtain it from locker J-1.

Kyoto Adventure opens after the credits. All 140 substories are available there without the story deadlines. The in-game quest records start over, and time-of-day and quest prerequisites still apply.

City exploration

Gion

Use Tatsuya, Kiryu's house by the main gate, as your base. Check its letters for commissions. Its hidden passage gives you access to Rakugai in Chapter 5. The Storage Lockers are in a nearby alley, and the Information Booth sits on the main street opposite Arigataya. For Tsuruya’s back entrance, look for the passage beside the Jizo statue.

Landmark What to do there
Tatsuya Read job letters, reach the Rakugai passage, and tend turtles once you have the Turtle Bucket
Arigataya and Tenguya Buy food or small gifts at the general store and medicine at the pharmacy
Ebisuya Pawn Sell valuables and visit for several commissions
Gion Inari Pick up Shichigoro’s Revelation pictures when his letters arrive and find outdoor shogi trials
Azamiya and Yumejiya Start the seven yujo routes and play their four parlor minigames
Komaki’s dojo Learn unarmed techniques in the southeast of Gion

Rakugai and the roads

Area Side activities and useful stops
Northwest Rakugai Read wanted posters at the police box from Chapter 6
Rakugai shopping district Visit Narikin for ranked shogi, Shirohebi Udon for food, and the turtle vendor for a free Turtle Bucket
Southeast Rakugai Visit the blacksmith, weapon shop, and Zanki Dojo
Rakugai theaters Kabuki Theatre hosts Star Actor after #32. The separate theater shows performances when you bring tickets earned at restaurants
Forest Path Find the horse archery stable near the Rakugai end
Mountain Path Visit the waterfall for rhythm training
Kawaramachi Visit Koetsu's mansion for Scarecrow and Jiraiya training
Riverside Path and Riverside Tea House Return for melon cutting from Chapter 9. The tea house has a palanquin stop
Hozoin Temple Enter the Hozoin Coliseum for repeatable tournaments from Chapter 9
Rendai Field and Sanjusangendo Visit the peddler for masks and take on the Tengu Mask duels later in the game

Palanquins open in Chapter 5 after the greatsword portion. Rides cost 71 mon. Visit the Yoshioka Dojo and Riverside Tea House on foot to add their stops. In #31 Where’s the Palanquin Bearer?, choose the top answer for the Great Torii stop or the bottom answer for the Back Alley stop. Use Jizo statues for saves and item storage, available from Chapter 5.

On the interactive map, select a venue to see its description, inventory or prize list where available. The blue dotted routes indicate story gates. Select an entrance pin to see the connected areas and jump to one.

Lockers and collectibles

Finish #104 Storage Locker Instructions in Chapter 5 before hunting for regular locker keys. The Locker Keys table lists 51 pickup locations for 50 lockers, including both versions of J-1.

The turtle vendor in Rakugai gives you a free Turtle Bucket. See Turtle Rescues for the one-time rescues and Wild Turtle Spawns for repeatable locations. To get the Eternal Turtle, complete all seven yūjo requests, read the final letter at Tatsuya and collect it from the tub.

The Collection Rewards checklist also covers sideshow tickets, Revelation pictures, Tengu masks and crafting books.

Minigames

Gion parlors and tabletop

The four parlor games below are offered during yūjo visits. The yūjo section explains the heart and visit requirements.

Minigame Where First tip
Konpira Fune Fune Yumejiya from 5-1 Listen for the knock when your opponent puts down the cloth. You can hold the cloth for up to three beats
Bottle Knockdown Yumejiya from 5-1 Start with the heaviest ball and five steps right, then adjust your aim
Iroha Karuta Azamiya from 5-1 Match the first kana you hear to the card. Pause to check the symbol if you need time
Fan Toss Azamiya from 5-1 Start with a partial pullback. Full power can send the fan over the target
Shogi Outdoor trials at Gion Inari from 5-1, ranked opponents at Narikin in Rakugai from 5-6 Learn piece movement and drops in the trials. Use takebacks where the board allows them
Mahjong Outdoor table at Tsurumachi Alley from 5-1, Rakugai parlour from 5-6 Keep a hand closed while learning riichi, and aim for a winning pattern with at least one yaku. Match results can affect your in-game money

Shogi trials · Ranked shogi

Skill games and challenges

Minigame Where and when First tip
Horse archery Forest Path stable, Chapter 5, day or evening Draw early. A charged arrow can pass through multiple targets when they line up
Waterfall Mountain Path from 6-3 Match the button to the timing marker. Recovery from temptation uses the controller’s motion sensor
Scarecrow Koetsu’s basement, Kawaramachi, from 6-6 Use one hit for a normal target and save stronger techniques for armored ones
Jiraiya Koetsu’s basement from 6-6 Learn which targets penalize you. Leave the penalty look-alikes alone
Star Actor Rakugai Kabuki Theatre at night after #32 Knock opponents down, then collect audience tips. Running and rolling reduce tips
Melon cutting Hozoin at 8-8, Riverside Path from 9-1 Use the stick to track high throws. Iron balls only score on a Great hit
Turtle raising and racing Free Turtle Bucket from the Rakugai turtle vendor, then Tatsuya and the race desk in Gion Enter your own turtle with full stamina and pick a race suited to its terrain stats

For unlock requirements, passing scores and saved checkmarks, see Yabusame, Waterfall Meditation, Scarecrow Formations, Jiraiya Chambers and Iaigiri Spirit Tempering.

Gyotensai’s inventions (22)

Visit Gyotensai’s house at the east end of Tsurumachi Alley in northeast Gion from 5-1. Speak to him and agree to bring ingredients, then select an invention from his list. Bring materials in your inventory and leave room for the prototype. Choosing the wrong mystery ingredient can waste the materials. Some recipes appear before you can obtain every ingredient. Sober Pill, Hunger Pill and Ultra All-Purpose Medicine are required for #97. Start that request before making the last of the 21 inventions, and finish your workshop visits before telling Itō you’re ready to leave Gion at 12-3.

KHHSubs’ training guide

Hozoin Coliseum

Return to Hozoin Temple after the Chapter 8 story tournament. From 9-1, speak to the receptionist and choose Select A Tournament. Each bracket has eight fighters and takes three wins to clear. There is no time limit. Healing items and armor effects are disabled. Between rounds you recover 30% of your maximum health and keep your Heat. Your fighting style stays fixed for the bracket. The last bracket lets you bring your own weapons.

Fighters

Defeat each of the 50 fighters once, then speak to the receptionist for the Ganryu Bokuto. All 50 defeats are also required for Request #100. Use View Opponent Information to check your in-game record. If a fighter is missing from a bracket’s entrant list, back out and select the tournament again to draw a fresh lineup. Ask the All-Seeing One beside the receptionist for hints about missing fighters and tournaments.

Finish Komaki’s training in Gion before telling Itō you’re ready to leave in 12-3 if you’re pursuing all 50 fighters during the story.

All fighters are checked off.

Completion and postgame

Use the Completion menu to track restaurant orders, lockers, Coliseum fighters, Heat Actions performed, abilities learned, weapons, yūjo, inventions, and minigames. Substories have their own records. Completing all 140 substories earns the Peerless Wakizashi.

Kyoto Adventure opens after clearing the game. It lets you do substories without chapter gates. Time-of-day and quest prerequisites still apply, and the substory records start over. The title screen also unlocks Ultimate Match, a separate set of 33 combat challenges.

Reference guides and credits

Thank you to Patrick Coffman (ThePatrick), KHHSubs, Aeris, and the English translation team for the walkthroughs, maps, and translation that helped make this guide possible. The in-game map artwork comes from Like a Dragon: Kenzan! by SEGA.

  • CyricZ’s Ishin guide provided the section layout.

  • Aeris’s Japanese walkthroughs helped cross-check Requests, Commissions, and Bounties.

  • KHHSubs’ substory guide helped cross-check quest steps, and its lettered maps supplied reference positions for starts and step pins. KHHSubs’ area maps helped identify landmarks and venues.

  • Patrick Coffman’s substory guide on Scribd was used to cross-check story requirements.

  • English translation patch on ModDB supplies the in-game names used in this guide.
